title: Multi-Qubit Dyadic Phase Fixing for Fault-Tolerant Quantum Compilation
summary: Fault-tolerant quantum computing requires translating application-level quantum circuits into the Clifford+$T$ gate set, where the $T$ gate is the dominant resource cost. Phase kickback is an ancilla-based technique that can dramatically reduce $T$-count for rotations with dyadic angles, but has previously been limited to highly structured circuit families. We present Dyadic Phase Fixing (DPF), a general multi-qubit synthesis tool that extends phase kickback to general quantum circuits. DPF uses numerical unitary synthesis to greedily extract dyadic angle rotations from any input circuit.…
